# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here a

progress on sustainability.

for generations to come.

living.

* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

to essential nutrients, our innovations help producers raise healthy livestock and poultry today,
and build a resilient foundation for the future.

Animal Nutrition & Health

[KH HEXAGON]
[KH HEXAGON]

**We are compelled to provide everyone the opportunity to live a healthier life. **We turn our
curiosity towards new ways to continuously enhance the health and wellness of people worldwide with
cutting-edge, science-backed ingredients to support vision, immunity, cognition, and more. 

Human Nutrition & Health

[PETFOOD_HEXAGON]
[PETFOOD_HEXAGON]

**We are compelled to provide safe and delicious ingredients to improve our pets’ food so they can
have the best quality of life.** From oxidation control and food safety to palatability and
nutrition, Kemin is** **compelled by curiosity to assure pets are living a happy and healthy life
around the world. 

Pet Food & Rendering

[FOOD TECH HEXAGON]
[FOOD TECH HEXAGON]

**We are compelled to help keep our food fresher and safer for longer.** Across the entire global
food supply chain, from meat and poultry to baked goods, our ingredients provide food manufacturers
with the ability to produce safe and high-quality food products to ensure that people have the
highest quality food products—for themselves and for families around the world. 

Food Technologies

[AQUA HEXAGON]
[AQUA HEXAGON]

**We are compelled to meet the growing demand for safe animal proteins from fish and shrimp**. Our
dedicated aquaculture experts and team of scientists are sharing and implementing innovative
solutions to improve quality and product efficacy within the industry. 

Aquaculture

[TEXTILE HEXAGON]
[TEXTILE HEXAGON]

Kemin delivers specialty textile enzymes that support fabric preparation, finishing, and garment
processing with efficient, science-based solutions.

Textile Enzymes

[BIOLOGICS HEXAGON]
[BIOLOGICS HEXAGON]

**We are compelled to empower immune resilience that enables animals to better perform and stay
healthy so producers can continue feeding the world. **With a strong awareness of global trends for
food and animal production, Kemin has a clear perspective on how to deliver trusted vaccine
technologies.** **

Biologics

[Browse Our Product Catalog][58]


At Kemin, we are compelled by curiosity.

It is the driving force that pushes us toward our vision of transforming lives. With science as our
foundation and an inextinguishable spirit of discovery, we strive to improve life for people, pets,
plants and animals. We embrace opportunities that allow us to explore creative solutions for the
world’s complex challenges. We look beyond what is—to see what could be.

[Learn More][59]

## 15

Kemin has more than 15 manufacturing facilities worldwide. 

## 90

Kemin operates in more than 90 countries.

## 120

Kemin customers are in more than 120 countries.

## 500+

Kemin offers more than 500 specialty ingredients to customers worldwide.

### Connect With Us

We would love to hear from you. Let us know how we can help.

ABOUT US

#### Our Responsibility

At Merck Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][220]

### Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
### people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
### increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][221]
[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][223]

#### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][224]

#### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][225]

#### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][226]

#### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][227]

#### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][228]

#### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][229]

### Research and Innovation

At Merck Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][230]

## News and Insights

[[icon: arrow-right] ][231]

for granted.

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

## Latest news
* 1 June 2026

  ### [Petra Volckaert appointed Chief Digital Officer at Nutreco][60]
  
  Read more

  Press Release
  
  ### [Nutreco scales intelligent shrimp farming ecosystem as price volatility pressures global
  ### producers][61]
  
  Read more
* 5 May 2026
  Sustainability
  
  ### [Nutreco cuts Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 47%, publishes its Impact Report 2025][62]
  
  Read more

[Discover our stories][63]

## Nutreco has two company business lines, operating in aquaculture and animal nutrition.

Skretting is a world leader in the manufacture and supply of aquaculture feeds, making it an
essential link in the feed-to-food chain.
[Explore Skretting][64]
Trouw Nutrition is a global leader in innovative feed specialities, premixes and nutritional
services for the animal nutrition industry.
[Explore Trouw Nutrition][65]

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

## Latest news

  Read more

  ### producers][61]
  
  Read more
* 5 May 2026
  Sustainability
  
  ### [Nutreco cuts Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 47%, publishes its Impact Report 2025][62]
  
  Read more

[Discover our stories][63]

## Nutreco has two company business lines, operating in aquaculture and animal nutrition.

Skretting is a world leader in the manufacture and supply of aquaculture feeds, making it an
essential link in the feed-to-food chain.
[Explore Skretting][64]
Trouw Nutrition is a global leader in innovative feed specialities, premixes and nutritional
services for the animal nutrition industry.
[Explore Trouw Nutrition][65]

# Commodities Group

Phibro’s team has deep expertise across all commodities including oil and oil products, natural gas,
natural gas liquids (NGL), electricity, renewable fuels, fertilizer, coal and emissions. Founded in
1901, Philipp Brothers (or PhibroTM as it became known) has a long heritage of innovation in the
commodities markets. Phibro was a pioneer in the development of liquidity and price transparency in
the global commodity markets. Phibro has operated in the US since 1915.

[ Learn more ][23]
 
 

# Meet The Team

Phibro is headed by CEO and President [**Simon Greenshields**][24], a prior member of [**Morgan
Stanley**][25]'s Management Committee and co-head of [**Morgan Stanley**][26]'s Commodity Division.

Earlier in his career at [**Morgan Stanley**][27], [**Mr. Greenshields**][28] ran and or founded
several market leading business lines including North American Power and Gas and Global Oil Trading.

The experienced management team is comprised of other senior [**Morgan Stanley Commodity**][29]
veterans including: [**Joseph Delaney** ][30]CFO, and[ **Fabrizio Zichichi** ][31]COO.

[**Mr. Greenshields** ][32]and his team helped build and run the **#1 ranked*** wall street
Commodity business, generating annual revenues of **over $3 Billion.**

### **PHIBRO IS A GLOBAL low carbon COMMODITY COMPANY, FOCUSED ON renewable ASSEts’ DEVELOPMENT,
### ACQUISITIONS,  OPTIMIZATIONs, AND related CONTRACT STRUCTURING.**

# Phibro’ s Purpose

Phibro's strategy is based on a proven track record of combining market insight, disciplined risk
management, and create risk-reward opportunities in low carbon emission and green commodities
markets.

[ core activites ][22]
 

# Global Energy

# &

# Commodities Group

Phibro’s team has deep expertise across all commodities including oil and oil products, natural gas,
natural gas liquids (NGL), electricity, renewable fuels, fertilizer, coal and emissions. Founded in
1901, Philipp Brothers (or PhibroTM as it became known) has a long heritage of innovation in the
commodities markets. Phibro was a pioneer in the development of liquidity and price transparency in
the global commodity markets. Phibro has operated in the US since 1915.

[ Learn more ][23]
 
 

# Meet The Team

Phibro is headed by CEO and President [**Simon Greenshields**][24], a prior member of [**Morgan
Stanley**][25]'s Management Committee and co-head of [**Morgan Stanley**][26]'s Commodity Division.

Earlier in his career at [**Morgan Stanley**][27], [**Mr. Greenshields**][28] ran and or founded
several market leading business lines including North American Power and Gas and Global Oil Trading.

The experienced management team is comprised of other senior [**Morgan Stanley Commodity**][29]
veterans including: [**Joseph Delaney** ][30]CFO, and[ **Fabrizio Zichichi** ][31]COO.

[**Mr. Greenshields** ][32]and his team helped build and run the **#1 ranked*** wall street
Commodity business, generating annual revenues of **over $3 Billion.**

### * Cumulative Risk Magazine Rankings

# Our Affiliates

[ Learn more ][38]

Phibro RenewOil provides nationwide used cooking oil collection and recycling services for
restaurants and commercial kitchens. With secure containers, real-time monitoring, and timely
pickups, RenewOil helps businesses turn waste into renewable fuel while supporting sustainability
goals.

[
][39]
[ Learn more ][40]

Phibro rCB recovers carbon black from end-of-life tires, creating a low-carbon alternative for use
in rubber, plastics, coatings, and more. By converting waste into valuable industrial materials,
Phibro rCB strengthens the circular economy and supports decarbonized manufacturing.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues. 

[Learn More][118]

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues. 

[Learn More][118]

# Animal Health Issues

The policies that keep animals healthy are thorough and multi-faceted; we are on the frontlines of
safeguarding animal welfare, food safety, and human health as related to animals.

### [New World Screwworm][35]

Protecting livestock, pets, wildlife, and people from New World Screwworm.

### [Unmet Animal Health Needs][36]

Advocating for regulatory processes and funding to keep animals healthy.

### [Animal Antibiotics][37]

Veterinarians work with doctors to fight antibiotic resistance.

### [Pet Affordability][38]

Protecting pet welfare and affordability for all.

### [Animal Medicine Compounding][39]

Ensuring compounded products are used safely and legally.

### [International Trade][40]

Advocating for science-based global trade policies.

### [Approval & Regulation of Animal Medicines][41]

Like human medicines, animal medicines are thoroughly regulated.

Washington’s favorite pet project.

Making economic and social contributions through innovations in animal health.

# Animal Health Resources

### HealthforAnimals: The Economic Value of Animal Health Sector

A report from HealthforAnimals shows how innovation within the animal health sector will continue to
support millions of jobs, drive investment, and strengthen food systems.

[DOWNLOAD PDF][52]
**Progress Report: Roadmap to Reduce the Need for Animal Antibiotics**

### Oxford Analytica: Healthy Animals Can Stabilize the Food Supply, Reduce Food Inflation, and Use
### Fewer Resources

***US Animal Health: Advancing and Securing Sustainability*** presents data that demonstrates how
healthy animals mean more income for farmers and more affordable nutrition for consumers.

[DOWNLOAD PDF][53]
**Oxford Analytica: Healthy Animals Can Stabilize the Food Supply, Reduce Food Inflation, and Use
Fewer Resources**

### FAO: How Prevention Can Reduce the Need for Antibiotics

A report from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) showcases the ways
prevention serves as the foundation of responsible use and action against AMR.

[DOWNLOAD PDF][54]
**FAO: How Prevention Can Reduce the Need for Antibiotics**

### A Flexible Signal Management Framework for Animal Health Pharmacovigilance

AHI has developed a framework for flexible signal management in the collection, detection,
assessment, monitoring, and prevention of adverse effects with medicinal products.

[DOWLOAD PDF][55]
**A Flexible Signal Management Framework for Animal Health Pharmacovigilance**

### Global Report: How Better Animal Health Supports Sustainable Food Systems

Healthier animals need fewer natural resources, allowing them to provide more food for less feed,
water, and land. Keeping animals healthy is central to achieving the United Nation’s Sustainable
Development Goals (UN SDGs) by 2030.

[DOWNLOAD PDF][56]
**Global Report: How Better Animal Health Supports Sustainable Food Systems**

### Progress Report: Roadmap to Reduce the Need for Animal Antibiotics

Nearly 200 nations around the world are taking collective action to address the global health
challenge of antibiotic resistance. In animal health, we’ve increased vaccine use, improved
diagnostics, and promoted judicious use of antibiotics.

[DOWNLOAD PDF][57]
**Progress Report: Roadmap to Reduce the Need for Animal Antibiotics**

# Featured Stories

June 30, 2026

### [Animal Medicines Aren’t Just Human Medicines][58]

Though they share many similarities, animal and human medicines have important differences. Animal
medications are specially designed to meet the unique needs of different species. Learn more about
how animal medicines are designed to keep animals healthy.

June 18, 2026

### [How to talk to your cat][59]

The science of cat cognition offers plenty of evidence that cats have highly developed
socio-cognitive skills. For example, cats are very good at following the visual signals of humans,
such as pointing with an arm or gazing in a certain direction. Read more about what we know about
communication between humans and cats.

June 16, 2026

### [Dog-Walking Seniors Have Better Balance][60]

As we age, balance can become more challenging. But seniors who regularly walk their dogs show
improved balance and fewer falls compared to their peers. Read more.

[MORE RESOURCES][61]

### About Animal Health Institute

The [Animal Health Institute (AHI)][62] represents the companies that develop and produce animal
medicines. Our industry is a global leader whose products improve the health of nearly 10 billion
companion and food-producing animals in the U.S., which results in significant economic and social
benefits for Americans.

The policies that keep animals healthy are thorough and multi-faceted; we are on the frontlines of
safeguarding animal welfare, food safety, and human health as related to animals.

water, and land. Keeping animals healthy is central to achieving the United Nation’s Sustainable
Development Goals (UN SDGs) by 2030.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

enhance nutrient availability, promote plant growth, and suppress harmful pathogens, ensuring
healthier crops and improved yields.

the molecular level for maximum efficiency and minimal environmental impact, resulting in enhanced
fertility and optimized plant nutrition.

management to renewable energy initiatives, helping businesses and communities reduce their
ecological footprint and foster a greener future.

Organic Plant Growth Promoters, Micronutrient Fertilizers, and more.
**
We, Krushi Bio Care, specialize as a manufacturer and supplier of an extensive range of Active Sulf
Fungicides, Micronutrient Fertilizers, Liquid Bio Insecticides, Organic Plant Growth Promoters, and
other products. Based on our rich industry experience and knowledge, we develop products that are
high-quality and durable. Our CEO, Mr. Bhavesh Vala, guides us at every business level and helps us
achieve new heights of success. Under his valuable guidance, we flawlessly carry out each of our
business operations, providing 100% customer satisfaction.

Our customers are the strongest pillars of support. We make sure that they continue to be our
supporters by fulfilling their requirements on time and exceeding their expectations every time. At
our company, all customers are provided with a smooth on-boarding process, reliable after-sales
services, hassle-free modes of payment, and many other advantages. However, we not only satisfy our
customers but strengthen their trust in us by working in the most fair manner.
**
Fulfilling Commitments **

Fulfilling commitments fosters a healthy relationship with customers and other business associates.
We believe that when we make promises, it becomes our number one priority to fulfill them within the
given time frame. This helps us establish trust with our customers. Therefore, to maintain lasting
bonds with our customers, we fulfill their requirements for Micronutrient Fertilizers, Liquid Bio
Insecticides, Organic Plant Growth Promoters, Active Sulf Fungicides, etc., on time.

**Why Choose Us? **

With excellence in business, we have attained a respectable position for ourselves in the industry.
Today, we are the number one choice of a large clientele. They appreciate us for the factors
mentioned below:

* Pocket-friendly Prices: All our products are priced at a rate that is reasonable and can be easily
  afforded by anyone.
* Adroit team of experts: Supported by a deft team of professionals, we effortlessly manage to pull
  off a smooth execution of all our business activities.
* Unparalleled Quality Products: Made with the best raw materials available in the market, our
  products are unbeatable in terms of quality and are safe to use.
* Wide Distribution Network: To cater to a large audience base with our top-notch products, we have
  developed a wide distribution network, sprawling over diverse regions across the entire country.
* Fair Business Practices: We lead the market by maintaining the highest standards of fairness
  across our business dealings and operations.
* Customer-Centric Approach: Our customers are very precious to us. We prioritize their requirements
  and demands to cultivate a lasting relationship with them.

PRODUCTS

## Our Products

MSD Animal Health is committed to protecting the health of animals and supporting a safe and
affordable food supply.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][208]
[[icon: arrow-right]][209]

Research Innovation

## Biopharma Research

Healthy animals are the foundation of a healthy world. As threats to animal health evolve, so do our
solutions.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][210]
[[icon: arrow-right]][211]

ABOUT US

## Our Responsibility

At MSD Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][212]

## Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
## people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
## increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][213]
[[icon: arrow-right]][214]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][215]

### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][216]

### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][217]

### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][218]

### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][219]

### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][220]

### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][221]

## Research and Innovation

At MSD Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## News and Insights

Read our latest news, announcements and resources.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][223]

### New Global Survey Shows Itch is Taking a Toll on Pets, Owners and Vets

A new global survey, “Pet Owner and Vet Perspectives on Canine Pruritus,” reveals that itchy skin
and allergic skin disease are among the most common reasons dogs visit the veterinarian. About one
in three canine patients in the U.S. (and more than one in four worldwide) are seen for itchy skin
or allergic skin disease, and about two in five dogs with skin conditions are newly diagnosed. The
impact extends well beyond the dog: 34% of U.S. dog owners (31% globally) say their dog’s allergic
skin disease significantly affects their own quality of life, and 61% of U.S. owners (60% globally)
have booked vet appointments specifically for their dog’s itchy skin.

[[icon: arrow-right] Read more ][224]

PRODUCTS

## Our Products

MSD Animal Health is committed to protecting the health of animals and supporting a safe and
affordable food supply.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][208]
[[icon: arrow-right]][209]

Research Innovation

## Biopharma Research

Healthy animals are the foundation of a healthy world. As threats to animal health evolve, so do our
solutions.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][210]
[[icon: arrow-right]][211]

ABOUT US

## Our Responsibility

At MSD Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][212]

## Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
## people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
## increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][213]
[[icon: arrow-right]][214]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][215]

### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][216]

### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][217]

### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][218]

### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][219]

### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][220]

### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][221]

## Research and Innovation

At MSD Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## News and Insights

Read our latest news, announcements and resources.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][223]

### New Global Survey Shows Itch is Taking a Toll on Pets, Owners and Vets

A new global survey, “Pet Owner and Vet Perspectives on Canine Pruritus,” reveals that itchy skin
and allergic skin disease are among the most common reasons dogs visit the veterinarian. About one
in three canine patients in the U.S. (and more than one in four worldwide) are seen for itchy skin
or allergic skin disease, and about two in five dogs with skin conditions are newly diagnosed. The
impact extends well beyond the dog: 34% of U.S. dog owners (31% globally) say their dog’s allergic
skin disease significantly affects their own quality of life, and 61% of U.S. owners (60% globally)
have booked vet appointments specifically for their dog’s itchy skin.

[[icon: arrow-right] Read more ][224]

Southern rockhopper penguins (Eudyptes chrysocome) navigate the rocky cliffs and crashing waves on
Marion Island, one of two Prince Edward Islands off the coast of South Africa. The penguins are
characterized by the spiky black-and-yellow feathers on their heads. They typically hop rather than
waddle along the rugged shorelines of islands north of Antarctica, which is how they got their name.

among the planet’s most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window
into a single hive, revealing its hidden world. With more than 20,000 bee species pollinating
one-third of the world’s food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence,
unlocking their secrets.

Subvention on working capital loans][202] [डीआईडीएफ][203] # ABOUT NDDB The National Dairy Development Board's (NDDB) creation is rooted in the conviction that our nation's socio-economic progress lies largely on the development of rural India. The Dairy Board was created to promote, finance and support producer-owned and controlled organisations. NDDB's programmes and activities seek to strengthen farmer owned institutions and support national policies that are favourable to the growth of such institutions. Fundamental to NDDB's efforts are cooperative strategies and principles. NDDB’s efforts transformed India’s rural economy by making dairying a viable and profitable economic activity for millions of milk producers while addressing the country’s need for self-sufficiency in milk production. NDDB has been reaching out to dairy farmers by implementing other income generating innovative activities and offering them sustainable livelihood. ## What's New * [Rate Agreements on Automatic Frozen Semen Thawing Kit][204] * [Labour Management Procedure for National Dairy Support Project-Phase II][205] * [Environment and Social Management Framework for National Dairy Support Project-Phase II ][206] * [Draft Stakeholder Engagement Plan for National Dairy Support Project Phase-II][207] * [Tender for Expression of lnterest (Eol) to establish digital interface / concepts in Livestock Sector][208] * [Breed Multiplication Farm][209] * [Interest Subvention on working capital loans][210] * [Latest Sire Proofs][211] * [Rates of interest with effect from 1st January 2026][212] ## Press Release * [World Biogas Association Confers an inaugural award “Strategic Leadership in the Global Biogas Sector” on Dr Meenesh Shah, Chairman, NDDB][213] * [Dr Meenesh Shah appointed as Chairperson of Executive Board of IRMA School][214] * [Historic dairy leap for Ladakh: Hon’ble Union Minister of Home Affairs & Cooperation inaugurates NDDB-managed Ladakh Milk Federation’s several farmer-oriented initiatives][215] * [NDDB Chairman and IDF Director General exchange agreement to host World Dairy Summit 2027 in India][216] * [IDF International Symposium on Sheep, Goat, Camel & other non-bovine milk commences at NDDB Anand][217] ## Latest Video * Embedded video for Film On NDDB [Film On NDDB][218] ## Links * [Dairy Cooperatives][219] * [Ministries/Departments][220] * [Subsidiaries][221] * [Sitemap][222] * [Privacy Policy][223] * [Disclaimer][224] ## Opportunities * [Career Opportunities][225] * [Business Opportunities][226] * [Consultancy Opportunities][227] #### Contact National Dairy Development Board Anand - 388 001, Gujarat, INDIA Telephone: 91-2692-260148 260149, 260159, 260160 Fax: 91-2692-260157, 260159 e-mail: [anand@nddb.coop][228] © 2017, National Dairy Development Board. Subvention on working capital loans][202] [डीआईडीएफ][203] # ABOUT NDDB The National Dairy Development Board's (NDDB) creation is rooted in the conviction that our nation's socio-economic progress lies largely on the development of rural India. The Dairy Board was created to promote, finance and support producer-owned and controlled organisations. NDDB's programmes and activities seek to strengthen farmer owned institutions and support national policies that are favourable to the growth of such institutions. Fundamental to NDDB's efforts are cooperative strategies and principles. NDDB’s efforts transformed India’s rural economy by making dairying a viable and profitable economic activity for millions of milk producers while addressing the country’s need for self-sufficiency in milk production. ### How does Remaker AI help improve content creation efficiency?

Remaker AI offers a full suite of intelligent tools that can automatically generate and process
images or videos based on simple user inputs. This dramatically saves time while significantly
improving content quality, making it suitable for all industries and creative scenarios.

watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

What types of private-label products does Supliful offer?

Supliful offers a range of private-label products, including supplements, coffee, skincare, and pet

How much does it cost to start a brand with Supliful?

You can start designing and publishing your products for **free**. To begin selling and fulfilling

annually). Unlike traditional wholesale, Supliful uses a print-on-demand model—you only pay for the
product and shipping once a customer buys from you. This allows you to launch your brand without any
upfront inventory investment.

  Who we are
  
  We are the global authority on animal health. Founded in 1924 as the Office International des
  Epizooties (OIE), in May 2003 we adopted the common name World Organisation for Animal Health. An
  intergovernmental organisation, we focus on transparently disseminating information on animal

  What we do
  
  We work to improve animal health and welfare across the globe. By collecting, analysing and

For more than 70 years, ZAGRO has been providing a wide spectrum of quality agrisolutions for the
agribusiness industry.

A leading agrisolutions manufacturer and distributor of animal health products, crop care products
and public health products, ZAGRO has its footprints in many parts of the world, in more than 70
countries.

ZAGRO animal health, crop care and public health agrisolutions products are manufactured by
state-of-the-art, GMP- and ISO-accredited manufacturing facility and quality-controlled by Pacific
Lab Services, a SAC-SINGLAS accredited and ISO/ IEC 17025:2005-awarded laboratory. With commitment
to quality and to further assure its partners of its product quality being on top-notch compliance
to very stringent quality standards, ZAGRO was awarded the ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000 for the
manufacturing, formulating and repacking of crop protection products. It is also awarded with GMP in
2004 in addition to its initial accreditation since 1999, the ISO 9002 and IEC Singlas. In April
2010, ZAGRO has achieved ISO 22000 Certification inclusive of HACCP Certification for all our
production facilities making it one of Asia’s First Animal Premix Plant to be accredited. In June
2011, they achieved the FAMI-QS Code of Practice for Feed Additives and Premixture Operators –
Version 5.

ZAGRO's commitment to crop care, animal health and public health products quality is equally strong
as its commitment to service. It is dedicated towards its partners and stakeholders in ensuring them
absolute business continuity irregardless of crisis or disaster hence as of July 2011, ZAGRO has
been certified for Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) SS540:2008 and BS25999-2:2007 which
equips us with Business Continuity Plans to identify risks and fully ensure business continuity once
exposed to any form of business disruption like building fires, earthquakes, floods, or national
incidents like pandemic illnesses.

Over the years it has proven to be one of the leading industry players catering to the needs of
farmers for animal health, crop care and public health and offering the most innovative and value
for money agrisolutions all year round. These achievements demonstrate its commitment to meeting
customers’ ever growing demand for the highest level of agrisolutions of crop care, animal health
and public health product and service quality.

For more than 70 years, ZAGRO has been providing a wide spectrum of quality agrisolutions for the
agribusiness industry.

A leading agrisolutions manufacturer and distributor of animal health products, crop care products
and public health products, ZAGRO has its footprints in many parts of the world, in more than 70
countries.

ZAGRO animal health, crop care and public health agrisolutions products are manufactured by
state-of-the-art, GMP- and ISO-accredited manufacturing facility and quality-controlled by Pacific
Lab Services, a SAC-SINGLAS accredited and ISO/ IEC 17025:2005-awarded laboratory. With commitment
to quality and to further assure its partners of its product quality being on top-notch compliance
to very stringent quality standards, ZAGRO was awarded the ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000 for the
manufacturing, formulating and repacking of crop protection products. It is also awarded with GMP in
2004 in addition to its initial accreditation since 1999, the ISO 9002 and IEC Singlas. In April
2010, ZAGRO has achieved ISO 22000 Certification inclusive of HACCP Certification for all our
production facilities making it one of Asia’s First Animal Premix Plant to be accredited. In June
2011, they achieved the FAMI-QS Code of Practice for Feed Additives and Premixture Operators –
Version 5.

ZAGRO's commitment to crop care, animal health and public health products quality is equally strong
as its commitment to service. It is dedicated towards its partners and stakeholders in ensuring them
absolute business continuity irregardless of crisis or disaster hence as of July 2011, ZAGRO has
been certified for Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) SS540:2008 and BS25999-2:2007 which
equips us with Business Continuity Plans to identify risks and fully ensure business continuity once
exposed to any form of business disruption like building fires, earthquakes, floods, or national
incidents like pandemic illnesses.

Over the years it has proven to be one of the leading industry players catering to the needs of
farmers for animal health, crop care and public health and offering the most innovative and value
for money agrisolutions all year round. These achievements demonstrate its commitment to meeting
customers’ ever growing demand for the highest level of agrisolutions of crop care, animal health
and public health product and service quality.
